run_sd3_dreambooth_lora_training: run Stable Diffusion 3 DreamBooth LoRA fine-tuning on Habana Gaudi HPU using argparse CLI
configure_training_arguments: configure training hyperparameters like learning rate, batch size, and checkpointing steps for SD3 LoRA training
encode_prompt_sd3: encode text prompts using dual CLIP and T5 text encoders for Stable Diffusion 3
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset to preprocess instance and class images with resizing, cropping, and normalization
validate_sd3_lora_model: run validation inference with the trained SD3 LoRA pipeline and log images to TensorBoard or W&B
